related.title: 科學級 CMOS 成像系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「光電轉換、吸收深度與量子效率」與「暗電流的溫度依存與冷卻設計」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；科學級 CMOS 成像系統的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Photoelectric conversion, absorption depth and quantum efficiency" and "Temperature dependence of dark current and cooling design" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Scientific CMOS imaging systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦背照式量子效率、電荷轉移效率、輸出放大器讀出雜訊、深冷暗電流與光子轉移增益校正；科學級 CMOS 成像系統則以背照式 sCMOS 的像素物理、讀出雜訊、快門時序、EMVA 1288 校正與系統訊噪比預算為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on back-illuminated QE, charge-transfer efficiency, output-amplifier read noise, deep-cooled dark current and photon-transfer gain calibration; Scientific CMOS imaging systems centres on pixel physics, read noise, shutter timing, EMVA 1288 calibration and system SNR budgets for back-illuminated sCMOS, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「背照式矽吸收層」與「背照式像素與釘扎光電二極體」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到科學級 CMOS 成像系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「固定圖樣雜訊：DSNU、PRNU 與影像校正」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Back-illuminated silicon absorber” and “Back-illuminated pixel and pinned photodiode”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Scientific CMOS imaging systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Fixed-pattern noise: DSNU, PRNU and image correction", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 科學級 CCD 成像系統
history.text: 1969 年貝爾實驗室的 Willard Boyle 與 George Smith 提出電荷耦合元件，2009 年因此獲得諾貝爾物理獎。1970 年代中期 JPL 與亞利桑那大學把 CCD 裝上望遠鏡拍攝行星，其遠高於底片的量子效率與線性很快讓 CCD 取代照相底片；1990 年哈伯太空望遠鏡的廣域行星相機即採用 CCD。近年魯賓天文台的 LSST 相機以 189 片科學 CCD 拼成 32 億像素焦面，每片分 16 個輸出並在約 2 秒內讀完。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1969 Willard Boyle and George Smith at Bell Labs conceived the charge-coupled device, earning the 2009 Nobel Prize in Physics. In the mid-1970s JPL and the University of Arizona put CCDs on telescopes to image planets, and their far higher quantum efficiency and linearity soon displaced photographic plates; the Wide Field/Planetary Camera launched on the Hubble Space Telescope in 1990 used CCDs. More recently the Rubin Observatory LSST Camera tiled 189 science CCDs into a 3.2-gigapixel focal plane, each read through 16 outputs in about 2 seconds. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「光電轉換、吸收深度與量子效率」到「相機驗收、多輸出串擾與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Photoelectric conversion, absorption depth and quantum efficiency" through "Camera acceptance, multi-output crosstalk and handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
